[{"nspname":"public","proname":"health_snapshot","definition":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.health_snapshot(tables jsonb)\n RETURNS TABLE(schema_name text, table_name text, max_time timestamp with time zone, count_24h bigint, error_msg text)\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n    t         jsonb;\n    schema_n  text;\n    table_n   text;\n    col       text;   -- freshness 欄（time_column）\n    partkey   text;   -- 單欄 RANGE 分區鍵欄名（非分區表為 NULL）\n    v_max     timestamptz;\n    v_count   bigint;\nBEGIN\n    FOR t IN SELECT jsonb_array_elements(tables)\n    LOOP\n        schema_n := t->>'schema';\n        table_n  := t->>'table';\n        col      := COALESCE(t->>'time_column', 'collected_at');\n        partkey  := NULL;\n\n        BEGIN\n            -- 查「單欄 RANGE 分區鍵」欄名（本 DB 一律 collected_at）。\n            -- partnatts=1 限單欄；partattrs 首元素為 attnum，>0 排除運算式分區鍵。\n            SELECT a.attname\n              INTO partkey\n              FROM pg_partitioned_table pt\n              JOIN pg_class     c   ON c.oid = pt.partrelid\n              JOIN pg_namespace nsp ON nsp.oid = c.relnamespace\n              JOIN pg_attribute a   ON a.attrelid = pt.partrelid\n                                   AND a.attnum = (split_part(pt.partattrs::text, ' ', 1))::smallint\n             WHERE nsp.nspname = schema_n\n               AND c.relname   = table_n\n               AND pt.partstrat = 'r'\n               AND pt.partnatts = 1\n               AND (split_part(pt.partattrs::text, ' ', 1))::smallint > 0;\n\n            -- ── max_time ──────────────────────────────────────────\n            -- tier-1：近 2 天窗口。分區表用分區鍵開窗 → pruning；freshness 欄有索引\n            --         → index range。窗口欄選擇：分區鍵存在且 ≠ freshness 欄時用分區鍵\n            --         （observed_at ≤ collected_at，最新 max(freshness) 必在最近分區內）；\n            --         否則用 freshness 欄自身。\n            IF partkey IS NOT NULL AND partkey IS DISTINCT FROM col THEN\n                EXECUTE format(\n                    'SELECT max(%I)::timestamptz FROM %I.%I WHERE %I >= now() - interval ''2 days''',\n                    col, schema_n, table_n, partkey\n                ) INTO v_max;\n            ELSE\n                EXECUTE format(\n                    'SELECT max(%I)::timestamptz FROM %I.%I WHERE %I >= now() - interval ''2 days''',\n                    col, schema_n, table_n, col\n                ) INTO v_max;\n            END IF;\n\n            -- tier-2：近 2 天無資料才 fallback 全表 max（低頻表或真停寫，罕見）。\n            IF v_max IS NULL THEN\n                EXECUTE format(\n                    'SELECT max(%I)::timestamptz FROM %I.%I',\n                    col, schema_n, table_n\n                ) INTO v_max;\n            END IF;\n\n            -- ── count_24h ─────────────────────────────────────────\n            -- 2026-09-04 Disk IO 事故後續（mig 400 點名的殘留項）：\n            -- 原本對每張表跑 count(*) 掃「過去 24 小時全部資料」，是 health_snapshot\n            -- 的成本主因（104 表累加 ~790 MB/次、~43 GB/天），索引與壓實都解決不了。\n            --\n            -- 消費端（data-collectors/tasks/daily_report.py 的 _section_health_summary\n            -- 與 _section_cross_layer）只用 `count_24h > 0` 當活性訊號，而\n            --     count_24h > 0  ⟺  v_max > now() - interval '24 hours'\n            -- v_max 上面已經算過（tier-1 index probe / tier-2 fallback），故此處零額外 IO。\n            --\n            -- 保留欄位形狀與 >0 語意 → 三個 Python 消費點（含 5 欄 positional unpack 的\n            -- monitoring.py 與 gis_collectors_monitor_snapshot.py）全部零改動、\n            -- 無部署順序風險。代價：此欄不再是真實筆數，只是 0/1 活性旗標\n            -- （現況無任何消費點顯示或使用其數值大小，僅用 >0 判斷）。\n            v_count := CASE WHEN v_max > now() - interval '24 hours' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;\n\n            schema_name := schema_n;\n            table_name  := table_n;\n            max_time    := v_max;\n            count_24h   := COALESCE(v_count, 0);\n            error_msg   := NULL;\n            RETURN NEXT;\n        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN\n            schema_name := schema_n;\n            table_name  := table_n;\n            max_time    := NULL;\n            count_24h   := NULL;\n            error_msg   := SQLERRM;\n            RETURN NEXT;\n        END;\n    END LOOP;\nEND;\n$function$\n"},{"nspname":"public","proname":"get_flight_dates","definition":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_flight_dates()\n RETURNS TABLE(date text, records bigint, flights BY day $function$\n"},{"nspname":"public","proname":"get_flight_trails","definition":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_flight_trails(target_date date)\n RETURNS TABLE(flight_id text, callsign jsonb, timeline text, point_count integer, confidence real)\n LANGUAGE sql\n STABLE\n SET statement_timeout TO '30s'\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\n    SELECT\n        m.vehicle_no,\n        m.city,\n        m.route_id,\n        m.trip_id,\n        m.segment_seq,\n        (\n            SELECT jsonb_agg(\n                jsonb_build_array(\n                    ROUND(ST_X(dp.geom)::numeric, 6),\n                    ROUND(ST_Y(dp.geom)::numeric, 6)\n                )\n                ORDER BY dp.path\n            )\n            FROM ST_DumpPoints(m.geometry) AS dp\n        ) AS polyline,\n        m.timeline,\n        m.point_count,\n        m.confidence\n    FROM live.waste_trails_matched_daily m\n    WHERE m.day = p_target_date\n      AND (p_cities IS NULL OR m.city = ANY(p_cities))\n      AND m.point_count >= 2\n    ORDER BY m.city, m.vehicle_no, m.trip_id, m.segment_seq;\n$function$\n"},{"nspname":"public","proname":"get_youbike_h3_dates","definition":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_youbike_h3_dates()\n RETURNS TABLE(date text, records bigint, date\n$function$\n"},{"nspname":"metadata","proname":"check_collector_freshness","definition":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION metadata.check_collector_freshness(p_threshold_min integer DEFAULT 30)\n RETURNS void\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'\nAS $function$\ndeclare\n  v_max_success timestamptz;\n  v_stale_min   numeric;\n  v_state       text;\n  v_token       text;\n  v_chat        text;\n  v_msg         text;\nbegin\n  select max(last_success_at) into v_max_success\n  from metadata.collector_status\n  where is_enabled;\n\n  -- 無資料（全空）視為異常\n  v_stale_min := extract(epoch from (now() - coalesce(v_max_success, 'epoch'::timestamptz))) / 60.0;\n\n  select state into v_state from metadata.alert_state where key = 'collector_freshness';\n  if v_state is null then\n    insert into metadata.alert_state(key, state) values ('collector_freshness', 'ok')\n    on conflict (key) do nothing;\n    v_state := 'ok';\n  end if;\n\n  select decrypted_secret into v_token from vault.decrypted_secrets where name = 'telegram_bot_token';\n  select decrypted_secret into v_chat  from vault.decrypted_secrets where name = 'telegram_chat_id';\n\n  if v_stale_min > p_threshold_min then\n    if v_state is distinct from 'alerting' then\n      v_msg := format(E'\\U0001F534 *Collector 資料停寫告警*\\n\\n已 %s 分鐘沒有任何 collector 成功寫入（門檻 %s 分）。\\n最後成功：%s',\n                      round(v_stale_min), p_threshold_min, coalesce(v_max_success::text, '(無紀錄)'));\n      if v_token is not null and v_chat is not null then\n        perform net.http_post(\n          url    := 'https://api.telegram.org/bot' || v_token || '/sendMessage',\n          body   := jsonb_build_object('chat_id', v_chat, 'text', v_msg, 'parse_mode', 'Markdown')\n        );\n      end if;\n      update metadata.alert_state\n        set state = 'alerting', last_change_at = now(), last_value = round(v_stale_min)::text\n        where key = 'collector_freshness';\n    end if;\n  else\n    if v_state = 'alerting' then\n      v_msg := format(E'\\U0001F7E2 *Collector 資料已恢復*\\n\\n寫入恢復正常（最後成功 %s）。', v_max_success::text);\n      if v_token is not null and v_chat is not null then\n        perform net.http_post(\n          url    := 'https://api.telegram.org/bot' || v_token || '/sendMessage',\n          body   := jsonb_build_object('chat_id', v_chat, 'text', v_msg, 'parse_mode', 'Markdown')\n        );\n      end if;\n      update metadata.alert_state\n        set state = 'ok', last_change_at = now()\n        where key = 'collector_freshness';\n    end if;\n  end if;\nend;\n$function$\n"}]
